Paula — appreciate the brief and the context. Looping in Ben (sales lead for mid-market) and Karthik (partner ops) so we can align commercial, ops, and enablement expectations.

Initial thoughts from Redwood:
- Commercial models to consider (we can draft a numerical example): referral fee, fixed reseller margin, or revenue-share (percentage of net subscription revenue).
- Lead registration: partner registers lead via HubSpot portal -> 30-day exclusive registration window from registration date. If no signed order in 30 days, the lead reverts to Redwood direct sales.
- Claim window / clawback: suggest a 180-day crediting window for renewals and upsells, with a 12-month clawback for chargebacks on refunded invoices.
- Escrow / large-deal protection: for ARR > $75k, we can put a 6-month escrow for recognition and tiered split until the customer is fully onboarded.

Can you confirm whether SparkBridge needs a larger exclusive registration window (we can be flexible for pilot accounts)? Also, please share any minimum margin thresholds you need for your GTM motion.

I'm attaching a draft calculation template (revshare_calculation.xlsx) and an internal playbook outline (playbook-draft.md) to speed things up.

I'll synthesize a short commercial proposal after we get your preference on registration window and margin target. If Friday still works for a sync, propose 10:30 am PT.

Hi Mina — thanks for the quick turn. We reviewed your sketches internally. High-level feedback: 

- Model preference: reseller with revenue-share works best for us. Target economics: SparkBridge seeks ~35% of net subscription revenue on deals we sell and a 20% referral fee where we simply introduce leads.
- Registration window: for pilot accounts we need a 90-day exclusive window to run our enablement and proof-of-value cadence. For standard leads, 30 days is acceptable.
- Claim window: 12 months for upsell/renewal credit makes sense to us, but we'd like the first-touch registrant to be prioritized for the first 6 months.
- Escrow: open to the escrow idea for deals > $100k ARR, would prefer a 9-month escrow period.

We attached a technical requirements doc for the connector (SparkBridge_config_requirements.pdf) and can provide anonymized win examples.

We can do Friday 10:30 am PT. Proposed attendees: Paula, Tom (engineering lead), Mina, Camila, Ben.

Thanks — looking forward to the call.

Best,
Paula

Internal summary / recommended approach before Friday's sync with SparkBridge: 

Quick summary of partner asks (from Paula):
- Reseller model with ~35% revshare target for partner-sourced deals; 20% referral for intros.
- 90-day exclusive registration for pilot accounts; 30-day standard for general leads.
- 12-month claim window; prioritize first-touch for first 6 months.
- Escrow for deals > $100k ARR, partner prefers 9-month hold.

Our recommended guardrails (draft):
1) Registration & exclusivity:
   - Standard: partner registers via HubSpot partner portal -> 30-day exclusive registration.
   - Pilot flag: partner can request "pilot" status at registration; CS/Product approves -> 90-day exclusive registration.
2) Claiming & attribution:
   - 12-month claim for renewals/upsells, with automatic priority to registrant for first 180 days.
   - All credits subject to signed order and invoice artifacts in HubSpot; ops can request proof for validation.
3) Escrow & large deals:
   - Escrow triggered for ARR >= $100k; funds held for 9 months with monthly release tied to onboarding milestones.
   - Clawback applies for refunds/chargebacks up to 12 months post invoice.
4) Financials & payout cadence:
   - Monthly reporting; payout net 30 after invoice recognition.
   - For revshare, use net subscription revenue after discounts and refunds.

Action items before the call: 
- Ben: populate revshare_calculation.xlsx with example deals (target: three scenarios: $20k ARR, $90k ARR, $250k ARR) and variant payouts (35% vs 30%).
- Camila: prepare a short partner contract template with pilot clause and registration process language (we'll keep it high-level for the sync).
- Karthik: confirm HubSpot partner portal registration form fields and what proof we'll require for claims (attachments list).
- Mina (me): consolidate notes and draft a one-page proposed commercial term sheet to send immediately after the call. I'll attach Redwood's initial proposal PDF to that email (redwood_proposal_v1.pdf).

Please reply with any showstoppers or if you want to change the default windows before I send our draft to Paula. If no objections, I'll lead the call and push the one-pager out the same day.

Thanks all,
Mina Haddad
Partner Ops | Redwood Inference
